prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1488; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you are comfortable with us recording this call?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened.

A: I was driving through Katy, Texas, on a main road heading toward a shopping center. I was in the left lane and wanted to turn left into the parking lot.

Q: Did you have a green light or a turn arrow when you began your turn?

A: I had a green light, but there was no separate arrow. I waited for a gap in oncoming traffic, and when it looked clear I started the turn.

Q: What happened next?

A: A vehicle coming from the other direction hit the front driver's side of my car. I didn't see it coming until it was almost on me. I tried to brake but there wasn't time.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did the airbags deploy?

A: The side airbag went off on my side. The steering wheel airbag did not.

Q: Can you describe any injuries you received?

A: My right shoulder hurts badly. It was hit against the door and the seatbelt caught me hard. I also have stiffness in my neck, but the shoulder is the main problem.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I was taken to an urgent care clinic that same day, and I have an appointment with an orthopedic specialist next week.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was driving carefully and I did not run the light. I just want my car repaired and my shoulder to get better.

Q: Thank you. That concludes this statement.

A: Thank you.
